description: This file is a PHP class definition for handling password forgotten email notifications within an OpenCart e-commerce system. The class extends the core Controller class and implements an index method that prepares and sends a password reset email to the customer.

classes.name: Forgotten
classes.description: A controller class responsible for sending password reset emails to customers who have forgotten their passwords.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Prepares and queues a password reset email to be sent to the customer, triggered when a customer requests password recovery.
